items.q: 📍 Où se trouvent les Duma Suites ?
items.a: Duma Suites se trouve au sein des Ghepard Towers à Watamu, comté de Kilifi, Kenya — à seulement 50 mètres de l'océan Indien et des sables immaculés de la plage de Watamu.

items.q: 🛏️ Quels types de suites sont disponibles ?
items.a: Nous proposons une gamme curatée de six suites distinctives : l'intime Duma Suite Anna (1 chambre, idéale pour les couples), les suites 2 chambres Lucia et Roma (parfaites pour les petites familles ou les amis), la spacieuse Duma Suite Alice 3 chambres (idéale pour les groupes jusqu'à 6 personnes), et nos spectaculaires Penthouse Suites Sofia et Chiara sur deux étages — le summum du luxe à Watamu.
Oui — la plage de Watamu est à seulement 50 mètres des Ghepard Towers. La plage est connue pour ses eaux cristallines, son sable blanc et sa vie marine vibrante.

items.q: ⏰ Quels sont les horaires d'arrivée et de départ ?
items.a: L'arrivée standard est à partir de 14h00 et le départ avant 10h00. Un départ anticipé ou tardif peut être arrangé sous réserve de disponibilité — veuillez nous contacter à l'avance.

Nous sommes heureux d'accueillir les petits animaux bien élevés pour assurer un séjour agréable à tous. Nous vous demandons de nous en informer à l'avance afin que nous puissions prendre les dispositions nécessaires.

Oui — nous avons deux piscines : une piscine de loisirs au rez-de-chaussée et une spectaculaire piscine à débordement sur le toit avec transats et serviettes. Les deux offrent des vues époustouflantes et sont accessibles quotidiennement de 09h00 à 21h00.

items.q: 💳 Quelle est la politique de paiement et d'annulation ?
items.a: Nous acceptons les principales cartes de crédit, virement bancaire et certaines méthodes de paiement mobile. Les conditions de paiement sont simples : 50 % à la réservation et 50 % à l'arrivée. Annulation avant 30 jours : entièrement remboursable. Annulation dans les 30 jours : non remboursable.

items.q: 📅 Quels sont les durées minimale et maximale de séjour ?
items.a: Notre séjour minimum est de 2 nuits, vous permettant de vraiment vous installer et de profiter de tout ce que Watamu a à offrir. Pour les séjours prolongés, nous accueillons les clients jusqu'à 6 mois.

Notre concierge peut organiser une large gamme d'activités, notamment des visites des ruines de Gedi, l'observation des éléphants au Tsavo, des croisières en boutre au coucher du soleil, la plongée en apnée au parc marin de Watamu, Safari Blue et des visites gastronomiques locales.
Oui, un parking privé sécurisé est disponible sur place aux Ghepard Towers sans frais supplémentaires pour les clients.

Absolument. Nos suites 2 et 3 chambres avec cuisines complètes sont idéales pour les familles. Les enfants sont les bienvenus et nous pouvons fournir des lits supplémentaires ou des équipements bébé sur demande.

Vous pouvez nous contacter directement via le formulaire de demande sur ce site, nous envoyer un e-mail à reservations@dumasuites.com, ou nous appeler. Nous confirmerons la disponibilité et vous fournirons un lien de réservation personnalisé.

items.title: Top 5 des activités sur la côte de Watamu
items.excerpt: De la légendaire excursion Safari Blue toute la journée et l'observation des dauphins à Mida Creek à l'exploration des anciennes ruines de Gedi, la plongée en apnée dans le parc marin de Watamu et une inoubliable croisière en boutre au coucher du soleil — Watamu offre des expériences extraordinaires pour tous les types de voyageurs.

items.title: Plats swahilis côtiers à absolument goûter
items.excerpt: La côte kenyane abrite l'une des traditions culinaires les plus distinctives d'Afrique. Du riz pilau parfumé et du biryani mijoté lentement aux pieuvres grillées fraîches et au festin de fruits de mer Safari Blue — voici les plats qui définissent l'expérience de la côte swahili.

excursions.title: EXPÉRIENCES SUR MESURE
excursions.note: Disponible uniquement pour les clients confirmés et les réservations

items.title: Ruines de Gedi
items.desc: Explorez l'un des sites archéologiques les plus remarquables de la côte est-africaine. L'ancienne ville swahili de Gedi, cachée dans une dense forêt côtière, remonte au XIIe siècle. Découvrez des mosquées en ruine, des vestiges de palais et le murmure d'histoires vieilles de plusieurs siècles — avec des singes résidents comme guides.

items.title: Observation des éléphants
items.desc: Embarquez pour une rencontre avec les géants bienveillants d'Afrique de l'Est dans leur habitat naturel. Une excursion d'une journée dans les iconiques zones de conservation des éléphants du Tsavo offre des rencontres rapprochées avec des éléphants sauvages, des girafes, des buffles et un paysage de savane époustouflant — à quelques heures de Watamu.

items.title: Croisière en boutre au coucher du soleil
items.desc: Naviguez vers l'heure dorée à bord d'un boutre en bois traditionnel le long du littoral de Watamu. Alors que le soleil se couche à l'horizon de l'océan Indien, savourez des fruits de mer frais, des boissons fraîches et la beauté sereine du tronçon de côte le plus célèbre du Kenya.

items.title: Marafa Hell's Kitchen
items.desc: Voyagez à l'intérieur des terres vers l'une des merveilles naturelles les plus époustouflantes du Kenya — la dépression de Marafa, connue localement sous le nom de 'Nyari'. Ces dramatiques ravins ocre et terre cuite brillent d'un feu surnaturel au lever et au coucher du soleil — un paysage unique sur la côte kenyane.

houseRules.title: Règlement de la maison
houseRules.subtitle: Résidence Ghepard Towers — Règlement d'utilisation des appartements et des parties communes
houseRules.intro: Chers clients et résidents, afin d'assurer une coexistence paisible et sécurisée au sein de la résidence Ghepard Towers, nous vous demandons de respecter les consignes comportementales suivantes :

sections.title: 1. Utilisation de la piscine
items: L'accès aux piscines est autorisé de 09h00 à 21h00.
Courir autour de la piscine du rez-de-chaussée et plonger sont strictement interdits.
La piscine sur le toit nécessite le plus grand soin : les mineurs ne sont pas autorisés sans adulte responsable.
Aucune nourriture, boisson ou objet fragile n'est autorisé dans ou autour de la piscine.
Les gonflables et les grands jouets de piscine ne sont pas autorisés.
Important : La direction n'accepte aucune responsabilité pour les accidents.

sections.title: 2. Utilisation responsable de l'énergie et des ressources
items: Nous encourageons une utilisation modérée de l'électricité et de la climatisation.
L'eau est précieuse — évitez le gaspillage.
Nous recommandons de réutiliser les serviettes.
En quittant l'appartement, éteignez le chauffe-eau, la climatisation et toutes les lumières.

sections.title: 3. Comportement & heures de silence
items: Les appareils audio à volume élevé ne sont pas autorisés dans les parties communes.
Les cris et le bruit sont interdits, notamment pendant la sieste (13h00–15h00) et la nuit (22h00–08h00).
Les feux ouverts, les BBQ ou les appareils à gaz non approuvés sont strictement interdits.

sections.title: 4. Protection des parties communes et des espaces verts
items: Il est interdit de marcher sur les pelouses.
Veuillez garder toutes les parties communes propres.
Les vélos, scooters et motos ne sont pas autorisés dans la résidence.
L'utilisation de mobilier non fourni par la résidence n'est pas autorisée.

sections.title: 5. Sécurité & gestion des appartements
items: La direction n'accepte aucune responsabilité pour les effets personnels laissés sans surveillance.
Nous recommandons d'utiliser le coffre-fort si disponible.
La résidence ne fournit pas de service de dépôt de clé.
Pour tout problème, contactez le propriétaire ou le gouvernant.
Tout dommage doit être indemnisé.

sections.title: 6. Accès, sécurité & enregistrement
items: La sécurité nocturne est active de 18h00 à 06h00.
L'enregistrement de tous les clients est obligatoire.
En cas de violation des règles, la direction se réserve le droit de contacter les autorités.

article1.metaTitle: Top 5 Activities on the Watamu Coast | Duma Suites Stories
article1.metaDesc: From Safari Blue full-day and half-day to Gedi Ruins, elephant watching and the Mida Creek boardwalk — discover the top activities on the Watamu coast, curated by Duma Suites.
article1.heroTitle: Top Activities on the Watamu Coast
article1.heroSub: Extraordinary experiences curated for Duma Suites guests
article1.introText: Watamu is one of East Africa’s most captivating coastal destinations — and the activities available here go far beyond simply relaxing on its legendary white-sand beaches. From ancient ruins hidden within a sacred forest to legendary full-day marine adventures, every experience here leaves a lasting impression.
article1.conciergeText: Our team personally curates and arranges every excursion below for guests staying at Duma Suites. Speak to us at check-in and we’ll tailor the perfect itinerary for your stay.
article1.bookCtaSub: Our concierge can arrange any of these experiences directly from Duma Suites.
article1.readNextTitle: Coastal Swahili Dishes You Absolutely Need to Try
article1.readNextExcerpt: Discover the extraordinary culinary traditions of the Kenyan Swahili coast — from fragrant pilau and coconut fish curry to the legendary Safari Blue seafood feast.
article1.cs1Title: A Guide to Watamu’s Best Beaches
article1.cs1Desc: The hidden coves, turtle nesting spots and sunset stretches of Watamu’s coastline — mapped for you.
article1.cs2Desc: A complete guide to the reefs, dive sites and marine life of Watamu Marine Park.
insiderTips: Book Safari Blue at least 2 days ahead — it fills fast during high season (December–February).
Visit Gedi Ruins early morning: cooler, quieter, and the colobus monkeys are most active at sunrise.
Bring binoculars to Mida Creek — the boardwalk rewards patience, especially at low tide.

quotes.text: Safari Blue was the most magical day of our entire trip — the dolphins, the reef, the feast on Sudi Island. Book it without hesitation.
quotes.author: Sarah M.

quotes.text: The Gedi Ruins tour arranged by Duma’s concierge was utterly unforgettable. You feel 800 years of Swahili history standing in those courtyards.
quotes.author: Marco T.

quotes.text: Mida Creek at low tide with herons and fish eagles circling overhead — we had no idea Watamu held something this serene.
quotes.author: Claire & James B.

activities.title: Safari Blue — Full-Day Excursion
activities.pullQuote: Spinner dolphins leap alongside the dhow as Watamu’s legendary full-day marine adventure unfolds before you.
activities.desc: Safari Blue is Watamu’s most iconic full-day marine adventure. Board a traditional wooden dhow and sail the crystal-clear waters off the Watamu and Mida Creek coast. The day begins with dolphin watching as spinner dolphins frequently leap alongside the dhow, followed by snorkelling over vibrant coral reefs at Watamu Marine Park. The highlight is a mid-day stop at Sudi Island for a fresh BBQ seafood feast on the beach — lobster, calamari, octopus and prawns grilled over charcoal. The full-day trip returns at sunset, leaving guests with one of the most complete and memorable days on the Kenyan coast.

activities.title: Safari Blue — Half-Day Option
activities.pullQuote: A condensed introduction to the magic of the Watamu coastline — dolphin watching and coral reefs await.
activities.desc: For guests with limited time, the Safari Blue half-day excursion offers the core marine experience without the Sudi Island seafood stop. You’ll enjoy dolphin watching and snorkelling over Watamu’s coral gardens aboard a traditional dhow, returning in the early afternoon. A wonderful condensed introduction to the magic of the Watamu coastline.

activities.title: Watamu Marine Park Snorkelling
activities.pullQuote: Turtles, reef sharks and a kaleidoscope of tropical fish — an accessible and unforgettable underwater world.
activities.desc: One of Kenya’s oldest and most protected marine national parks sits right on Watamu’s doorstep. The coral gardens here are home to turtles, reef sharks, stingrays, vibrant tropical fish and an incredible diversity of corals. Whether you’re a seasoned diver or a first-time snorkeller, the Marine Park offers an accessible and unforgettable underwater world.

activities.title: Gedi Ruins — Ancient Swahili City
activities.pullQuote: The haunting remains of a 12th-century Swahili trading town, still debated by historians — and still spellbinding.
activities.desc: Tucked within a dense coastal forest just outside Watamu lies the Gedi Ruins — the haunting remains of a 12th-century Swahili trading town abandoned for reasons still debated by historians. Wander through crumbling mosques, royal palaces and merchant houses as resident colobus monkeys leap overhead. Guided tours bring the site’s extraordinary history to vivid life.

activities.title: Elephant Watching at Tsavo
activities.pullQuote: Kenya’s largest elephant herds roam here — the famous red elephants of Tsavo, dusty with iron-rich soil.
activities.desc: A few hours from Watamu, the vast Tsavo East and West national parks are home to Kenya’s largest elephant herds. A full-day safari here offers close encounters with these gentle giants alongside lions, giraffes, buffalo, zebra and the famous “red elephants” of Tsavo — dusty-red from rolling in the iron-rich soil. An unmissable East African wildlife experience.

activities.title: Mida Creek Mangrove Boardwalk
activities.pullQuote: A birdwatcher’s paradise — over 100 species recorded in the ancient mangrove forests of Mida Creek.
activities.desc: Mida Creek is a protected tidal inlet fringed by ancient mangrove forests. The elevated boardwalk offers a tranquil walk through the ecosystem at low tide, with sweeping views across the creek and the Indian Ocean beyond. The creek is a birdwatcher’s paradise — over 100 species have been recorded here, including herons, flamingos, fish eagles and kingfishers. A serene and restorative experience away from the beach.

article2.metaTitle: Coastal Swahili Dishes You Absolutely Need to Try | Duma Suites Stories
article2.metaDesc: Discover the extraordinary culinary traditions of the Kenyan Swahili coast — from fragrant pilau and coconut fish curry to the legendary Safari Blue seafood feast.
article2.heroTitle: Coastal Swahili Dishes You Absolutely Need to Try
article2.heroSub: A culinary journey along the Kenyan coast — curated by Duma Suites
article2.introTitle: The Flavours of the Swahili Coast
article2.introText: The Kenyan coast carries within it one of the world’s most distinctive culinary traditions. Born from centuries of Indian Ocean trade, the Swahili kitchen blends Arab spice routes, Indian aromatics, Persian rice techniques and African coastal ingredients into a cuisine that is at once deeply rooted and endlessly surprising. Here are six dishes you must seek out during your stay in Watamu.
article2.conciergeText: Our team can recommend the best local restaurants in Watamu and arrange transport to the most authentic spots. For the Safari Blue seafood feast, speak to us at check-in.
article2.closingText: Our concierge team can recommend the best local restaurants in Watamu and arrange transport to the most authentic spots. For the full Safari Blue experience and its unforgettable seafood feast, speak to us when you book your stay.
article2.prevTitle: Top Activities on the Watamu Coast
article2.prevExcerpt: From the legendary Safari Blue full-day excursion and dolphin watching to the ancient Gedi Ruins and the Mida Creek mangrove boardwalk — Watamu’s finest experiences, curated for you.

article2.cs2Desc: The sights, smells and stories of the most vibrant fish market on the Kenyan coast — a must for food lovers.
foodTips: Ask the Duma Suites team for their current favourite local restaurant — recommendations change with the season.
The freshest pilau in Watamu is found at small family-run eateries, not tourist-facing restaurants.
Fresh coconut milk for wali wa nazi should always be squeezed the same day — tinned coconut simply cannot match it.

quotes.text: The pilau at the restaurant recommended by Duma’s team was unlike anything I’d ever tasted. Pure coastal magic — we went back three evenings in a row.
quotes.author: Aarav K.

quotes.text: Safari Blue’s octopus on the sandbank — charcoal-grilled, fresh from the ocean, eaten with our hands. We still talk about it two years later.

dishes.title: Pilau
dishes.pullQuote: No coastal celebration is complete without it — fragrant basmati rice perfected on the Kenyan coast for centuries.
dishes.desc: Pilau is the soul of Swahili cuisine — fragrant basmati rice slow-cooked with a rich blend of whole spices including cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, cumin and black pepper. Often prepared with tender beef or chicken that has been marinated overnight, the result is an aromatic, deeply savoury rice dish that has been perfected on the Kenyan coast for centuries. No coastal celebration is complete without it.

dishes.title: Mchuzi wa Samaki
dishes.pullQuote: A silky, golden curry best enjoyed with white rice — and ideally eaten with a view of the Indian Ocean.
dishes.desc: Coastal Kenya’s quintessential fish curry — mchuzi wa samaki is made with whatever the fishermen bring in that morning. Fresh snapper, kingfish or barracuda is simmered in a base of tomatoes, onions, garlic, ginger, turmeric and the essential ingredient: coconut milk. The result is a silky, golden curry with a gentle heat that is best enjoyed with white rice or fresh chapati, and ideally eaten with a view of the Indian Ocean.

dishes.title: Safari Blue Seafood Feast
dishes.pullQuote: Eating with your hands in the Indian Ocean breeze makes this a meal you will never forget.
dishes.desc: If you join the legendary Safari Blue excursion, you will experience one of the Kenyan coast’s most celebrated dining traditions — a fresh seafood feast cooked on a sandbank island. Lobster, calamari, octopus, prawns, crab and fresh fish are grilled over charcoal or cooked in coconut broth, accompanied by Swahili sides and cold drinks. Eating with your hands in the Indian Ocean breeze makes this a meal you will never forget.

dishes.title: Coconut Rice (Wali wa Nazi)
dishes.pullQuote: Paired with grilled fish or a spoonful of mango achaar — comfort food at its most elegant.
dishes.desc: Wali wa nazi — rice cooked in fresh coconut milk — is the everyday companion to almost every Swahili coastal dish. The coconut milk is squeezed fresh from grated coconut flesh, giving the rice a subtle sweetness, creaminess and a perfume unlike anything you can achieve with ordinary water-cooked rice. Paired with grilled fish, a vegetable curry or simply with a spoonful of mango achaar, it is comfort food at its most elegant.

dishes.title: Biryani
dishes.pullQuote: A benchmark by which local cooks measure their mastery — the Swahili coast biryani is in a class of its own.
dishes.desc: The Swahili coast biryani is distinct from its South Asian cousins — richer in spice, more intensely fragrant, with layers of saffron-coloured rice interlaced with slow-cooked spiced meat (usually goat or chicken), fried onions, raisins and a drizzle of ghee. Served on festive occasions and at weddings, a good coastal biryani is the benchmark by which local cooks measure their mastery.

dishes.title: Grilled Octopus (Pweza)
dishes.pullQuote: The outside chars beautifully while the inside stays tender — a dish you will seek out at every opportunity.
dishes.desc: Along Watamu’s shores, fishermen haul in octopus on their daily runs. Tenderised by hand on the rocks at low tide, the octopus is then marinated in lime, garlic, chilli, coconut milk and spices before being grilled directly on charcoal. The outside chars beautifully while the inside stays tender and juicy. Served with a squeeze of fresh lime and a simple tomato salsa, pweza wa kukaanga is a dish you will seek out at every opportunity.

cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, which ones we use on the Duma Suites website, why we use them, and how you can manage your preferences. By continuing to browse our site, you agree to our use of cookies as described below.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by a website when you visit it. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a period of time, so you don't have to keep re-entering them whenever you come back to the site.
bullets: Stored locally in your browser
Cannot run programs or deliver viruses
Do not access personal files on your device
Can be session-based (deleted on close) or persistent (retained across visits)

sections.title: 2. Cookies We Use
sections.content: We use three categories of cookies on the Duma Suites website, each serving a distinct purpose:

categories.name: Essential Cookies
categories.desc: These cookies are strictly necessary for the website to function. They enable core features such as page navigation, security, and access to protected areas. The site cannot function properly without them. They do not store any personally identifiable information.

categories.name: Analytics Cookies
categories.desc: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting anonymised information about pages visited, time spent on site, and how guests arrived. We use Google Analytics with IP anonymisation enabled.

categories.name: Preference Cookies
categories.desc: These cookies remember your choices — such as your language preference (English or Italian) — so that your experience feels personalised and consistent on every visit.

sections.title: 3. Why We Use Cookies
sections.content: Each category of cookie serves a specific purpose in delivering the finest experience to our guests:

reasons.label: UX Improvement
reasons.desc: Analytics data helps us identify and fix friction in the guest journey — from browsing suites to completing an enquiry.

reasons.label: Personalisation
reasons.desc: Preference cookies ensure the site remembers your language and settings, so every visit feels tailored to you.

reasons.label: Security
reasons.desc: Essential cookies protect you by maintaining secure, authenticated sessions and preventing cross-site request forgery.

reasons.label: Performance
reasons.desc: We use session data to optimise page load times and serve the most relevant content to guests from different regions.

sections.title: 4. Managing Your Preferences
sections.content: You are in full control of your cookie preferences. Here are the ways you can manage them:
bullets: Use the cookie banner that appears on your first visit to accept, reject or customise cookie categories.
Clear your cookie preferences at any time by clicking "Manage Preferences" in the cookie banner (reappears after clearing local storage).
Adjust your browser settings to block or delete cookies entirely — note this may affect site functionality.
Opt out of Google Analytics tracking at any time via: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

sections.title: 5. Updates to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legislation, or our services. When we do, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
